pages.text: One book + one slimeball makes this guide. No fixed arrangement; a 2×2 grid works. Patchouli must be installed.
Browse categories or use Search. Item icons have normal tooltips. Links open related entries. Every entry is available immediately; no advancement is needed.
Book text follows the game language: English, Korean, Japanese, or Spanish, with English fallback for other languages. See $(l:basics/first_steps)First steps$() and $(l:basics/tuner)Slime Tuner$().
